The larger circle on the left is labeled "Virtual Characters" and is colored blue, representing approximately 60% of the total diagram area. The smaller circle on the right is labeled "Real Characters" and is colored green, representing approximately 40% of the total diagram area. The two circles overlap, with the overlapping section labeled "Custom Characters" and colored pink. The "Virtual Characters" circle is further divided into 5 sections: "Comic Characters", "Movie Characters", "Teleplay Characters", "Novel Characters", and "Game Characters", all colored in different shades of blue. The "Real Characters" circle is divided into 7 sections: "Scientists", "Artists", "Athletes", "Writers", "Musicians", "Actors", and "Influencers", all colored in different shades of green. The diagram does not include a legend or percentage labels, but the sections within each circle appear to be arranged in a rough clockwise order.

The outer layer is divided into eight segments and expands on the categories of the inner layer, with "Virtual Characters" further divided into "Movie Characters", "Teleplay Characters", "Novel Characters", "Game Characters", and "Comic Characters", all in blue. "Real Characters" is further divided into "Scientists", "Artists", "Athletes", "Writers", "Musicians", "Actors", and "Influencers", in green, with "Influencers" being the largest segment among them, and "Scientists" the smallest.
